blurb: Kemah Boardwalk Marina offers over 400 well-maintained slips for various vessel sizes with secure and convenient access to Clear Lake and Galveston Bay. They provide charters including catamaran charters by the hour, half day, and full day, as well as catamaran sales and sailing lessons. Amenities include docking assistance, pool, lounge areas, grills, showers, and proximity to restaurants and entertainment.
extraNote: Marina located on the bay side of the south-end base of the Kemah-Seabrook Bridge on Hwy 146
